intent.proves: At least one active product carries a video file asset.
intent.scope: active products of the declared product scope, every language; complete SQL enumeration

bindings.reason: get_product_images reads one product at a time; no complete host enumeration of details.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.DetailProductId) FROM EcomDetails d WHERE d.DetailType = 0 AND (LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.mp4' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.m4v' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.mov' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.webm' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.mkv' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.ogv' OR LOWER(d.DetailValue) LIKE N'%.avi') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductId = d.DetailProductId AND p.ProductActive = 1{inScope})
